name: North Quincy Plaza
summary: North Quincy Plaza is a fully-leased, grocery-anchored shopping center offering 80,510 square feet of retail space in the heart of Quincy's Greater Boston trade area. Managed by Kimco Realty, this community center serves local residents with a strong mix of national and regional tenants meeting everyday shopping needs.
demographics: North Quincy Plaza serves a diverse, middle to upper-middle class population with a median household income of $101,426 within a 1-mile radius, increasing to $108,986 within 10 miles. The trade area encompasses over 32,000 residents within one mile and nearly 1.5 million within 10 miles, with an average household income of $123,414 locally. The center attracts working professionals and families from the Greater Boston MSA, particularly from Quincy and surrounding communities, who seek convenient grocery shopping and everyday retail services. The daytime population of over 2.1 million within 10 miles indicates strong commuter traffic and workplace proximity, making it ideal for quick shopping trips and essential services.
description: North Quincy Plaza is a well-established grocery-anchored shopping center strategically located at 475 Hancock Street in Quincy, Massachusetts, serving the Greater Boston-Cambridge-Newton metropolitan area. Spanning 80,510 square feet of gross leasable area, this community-focused center has become a vital retail destination for local residents and commuters alike. The property features a carefully curated mix of national and regional tenants designed to meet the everyday needs of the surrounding population, with convenient access from major thoroughfares in the North Quincy trade area. Currently fully leased with a waitlist for future availability, North Quincy Plaza demonstrates strong market demand and tenant retention, reflecting its prime location and solid performance in one of New England's most dynamic retail markets. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, the property benefits from professional management and a commitment to serving both tenants and the local community.
